title: Apex Velocity: Alpine Drift
subtitle: Console-grade mountain circuit racing with real-time wet-asphalt physics
description: Apex Velocity: Alpine Drift delivers precision chassis telemetry, dynamic rain hydroplaning, and 18 licensed alpine pass circuits engineered for 60 FPS mobile play. Customize suspension geometry, gear ratios, and aerodynamic downforce with zero energy timers or pay-to-win walls.
changelog: Added Fjords Dawn endurance circuit, improved Vulkan shader compilation on Snapdragon 8 Gen series, and reduced initial APK footprint by 14 MB.

title: Skyward Citadel Chronicles
subtitle: Tactical action RPG set across floating monolith sanctuaries
description: Ascend the fractured sky bridges of the Ancient Citadel in a single-player and co-op action RPG featuring directional parrying, elemental rune crafting, and seamless offline campaign progression. Full controller support included out of the box.
changelog: Introduced the Sunlit Monolith raid chapter, balanced parry stagger windows across heavy weapons, and added 120Hz frame-pacing mode.

title: Chroma Synth: Prism Beat
subtitle: Precision geometric rhythm arcade with custom track importer
description: Navigate rotating acoustic rings and refract light pulses in lockstep with studio-mastered electronic soundtracks. Features sub-millisecond audio latency calibration, 48 handcrafted levels, and an offline beatmap editor.
changelog: Added USB-C DAC low-latency audio path, 6 new Prism Master stages, and refined touch hit-window tolerance.

title: VaultPulse APK & Privacy Kit
subtitle: Offline package inspector, permission auditor, and encrypted file vault
description: Inspect APK signatures, verify SHA-256 digests locally on-device, audit app background trackers, and store sensitive backups inside an AES-256 hardware-backed vault without cloud sync or telemetry.
changelog: Added split-APKS/XAPK manifest verification, Android 15 predictive back gesture support, and instant QR hash sharing.
